g1-implement.title: Gap-scale module: implement
g1-implement.imperative: Create the pure module src/evo_predictor/quali_gap_scale.py. PUBLIC API: (1) expected_gap_ij(pi_i: float, pi_j: float, s: float) -> float = s*(pi_i - pi_j) (fraction-of-median units; the #386 contract function); (2) expected_gaps(pi: Mapping[str,float], s: float, *, reference='median') -> Dict[str,float] returning per-driver gap-to-reference (s*(pi_d - ref(pi))), the field-level expression; (3) prediction-time scale providers -- TWO carry-forward variants (Admiral correction) plus the baseline: (3a) carry_forward_scale(history: Sequence[SpreadTargetRecord-or-float]) -> Optional[float] = LAST-KNOWN prior-event quali s_e (None if no history); (3b) same_circuit_prior_year_scale(prior_year_record_or_value) -> Optional[float] = the SAME-CIRCUIT PRIOR-YEAR quali s_e (None if absent) -- same artifact, different lookup key (spread is plausibly track-structured: Monaco vs Monza); (3c) global_constant_scale(records) -> float (mean/median s_e over a fitting pool; the status-quo-ante baseline that both carry-forward variants must beat). NOTE the vacuous 'persistence baseline' is DROPPED -- it was identical to carry_forward_scale (Admiral). Validate inputs (name field/expectation/actual on failure). NO change to spread_target.py, no retro touch, no pi-semantics change, DB not required by the pure module (circuit->round resolution from get_calendar happens in the harness, not the pure module; the pure provider takes the already-looked-up prior-year record/value). Write tests/unit/evo_predictor/test_quali_gap_scale.py covering the formula (sign, scale, monotone-invariance of ORDER under positive s), reference handling, empty/single-driver, both carry-forward variants' None-on-empty, and constant-scale aggregation. Fill IMPLEMENTER_HANDOFF; play implementer in-context (no nested dispatch per Admiral order) with strict role discipline. Run targeted pytest, pyright on touched, py -m src.utils.simplification_limits on touched. Return IMPLEMENTER_RESULT.

g2-implement.title: Gap-MAE measurement harness + OOS result: implement
g2-implement.imperative: Create scripts/diagnose_quali_gap_scale.py (DB + committed artifacts; stdlib + numpy; py; deterministic; foreground <=10 min). For each quali event with a committed quali s_e (params/spread_target/<y>/<r>/quali.json), read-only retro quali pi (retro_loader), and observed quali gaps (compute_pace_gaps over db.get_quali_best_valid_laps_batch): compute predicted pairwise gaps under these scale sources -- (A) EVENT-CONDITIONED s (the committed per-event quali s_e = the achievable label-side ceiling, for reference); the TWO prediction-time CARRY-FORWARD variants that must beat the baseline (Admiral correction): (CF1) LAST-PRIOR-EVENT carry-forward s_hat_e (last-known prior quali event s_e, as-of safe), and (CF2) SAME-CIRCUIT PRIOR-YEAR s_hat_e (prior-year same-GP quali s_e via get_calendar GP-name lookup; as-of safe -- prior year is always before the event); and (B) GLOBAL-CONSTANT s (single s fit on the train pool, the status-quo-ante baseline that must fall). DROP the vacuous persistence source (it was identical to CF1 -- Admiral). Metric: pairwise gap-MAE = mean |predicted_gap_ij - observed_gap_ij| over undirected non-tie pairs, plus a calibration view (slope/intercept or binned predicted-vs-observed). Slice: OVERALL and MIDFIELD (both drivers' quali positions in 6-15, matching diagnose_quali_same_pairs MIDFIELD_LO/HI). Regimes: OOS 2025 (clean, primary) and a LOSO-style/train-pool view for context; never pool across regimes. ALSO report the ordering KPIs (pairwise sign-acc / rank proxy) under each scale source to DEMONSTRATE they are FLAT/identical across scales (the monotone-invariance confirmation; reuse the pairwise sign primitive convention). DETERMINE THE WINNER between CF1 and CF2 by OOS midfield gap-MAE and emit it as the recommended default ŝ_e source in the JSON (field e.g. recommended_shat_source). Write evidence JSON to .agent-work/issue-391-quali-gap-scale/evidence/quali_gap_scale_numbers.json and print a report. Add a focused test (tests/unit/evo_predictor/ or tests/regression/) on the harness's pure scoring helpers (gap-MAE on a tiny synthetic event; flat-ordering assertion; winner-selection helper). Fill IMPLEMENTER_HANDOFF; play implementer in-context. Run the script foreground, capture numbers, run targeted pytest + pyright + simplification_limits on touched. Return IMPLEMENTER_RESULT INCLUDING the headline numbers (gap-MAE event-conditioned vs CF1 vs CF2 vs global-constant, OOS midfield), the chosen-default winner, and the flat-ordering confirmation.

postconditions.statement: IMPLEMENTER_RESULT returned with measured numbers and no unresolved blockers

constraints: NO retrain, NO NN inference: only committed s_e + read-only retro pi + DB. If any path needs a retrain or multi-hour run -> STOP and report.
As-of discipline: the prediction-time s_hat_e must use ONLY prior-event s_e (no leakage of the event's own label into its prediction).
Reuse, do not fork: import compute_pace_gaps, the gap-scale module, and the retro_loader; midfield band matches the existing same-pairs diagnostic.
py not python; targeted pytest only; pyright-clean on touched; simplification_limits on touched.

HONEST-OUTCOME: if NEITHER carry-forward variant (CF1 last-prior-event, CF2 same-circuit-prior-year) beats global-constant on midfield gap-MAE OOS, report that plainly -- it is a valid result and the #386 contract deliverable stands regardless.
